component.name: BrewCV
component.summary: Tailor a résumé from one record

description.p: BrewCV keeps every claim you can make about your work, each in one or more worded versions and languages, and builds a résumé for a job by choosing among wordings you wrote. It never writes a claim for you.
Everything stays on this computer: the Flatpak has no network permission. You can link a folder to keep your record and saved resumes in, and export the résumé as a PDF through the print dialog.
This is an experimental desktop build of the BrewCV web app.
